questions.passage:
Since the year 2000, the Serpentine Gallery in the UK has annually invited distinguished architects from around the world to design a pavilion, which provides a place of rest for visitors.

(A) The pavilion's roof, resembling the wide branches of a tree, includes a transparent layer that allows sunlight to spread into the pavilion below. Visitors may enter the pavilion through one of its four entrances and sit around the central ring to look up at the sky.

(B) In 2017, the honor was extended to Kéré. Drawing inspiration from his hometown, where locals would gather to work, converse, and study beneath the shade of trees, he modeled his design after a large tree.

(C) The pavilion's exterior walls, shaped like triangles and made of blue wooden blocks, reflect Kéré's cultural heritage. In his hometown, residents traditionally wear blue clothing during times of celebration, and the triangles symbolize luck and confidence.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [흐름] 주어진 글: 서펜타인 갤러리 건축가 초대 → (B) 2017년 케레 초대, 나무 모델 디자인 → (A) 지붕이 나무 가지를 닮음, 4개 입구 → (C) 외벽 삼각형 블록, 문화유산 반영.
det.correct: ① (B)-(A)-(C): 초대 → 지붕 → 외벽 순서로 자연스러움 ✅ / ② (A)-(C)-(B): 초대 전 지붕 설명 → 단절 ❌ / ③ (C)-(B)-(A): 외벽이 먼저 → 부자연스러움 ❌ / ④ (B)-(C)-(A): 외벽→지붕 순서 부자연 ❌ / ⑤ (A)-(B)-(C): 초대 없이 지붕 설명 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 순서 배열: 주어진 글 invited architects → (B) the honor was extended to Kéré (초대) → (A) The pavilion's roof (지붕 구조) → (C) exterior walls (외벽). annually = 매년. distinguished ≈ renowned
